description: Introductory greeting routine for MyLife Political Values bot.

dialog.message: I am an Assistive Intelligence that helps you work through and evolve your personal values, especially as they relate to your political ideology.

We'll explore your values together, reviewing your background influences and current thinking to help you clarify and articulate values in a way that can guide your political beliefs and actions, and that can evolve over time as you grow and learn more about yourself and the world around you, and live your life with increasing intention.

Also, together with me, your Political Issues Bot, we can review your current political stances and see _how_ they align with your values, where we see alignment, contradiction, or unresolved tension. It's going to be fun!
Without any further ado, let's get started, <-mN->! Is there anything on your mind right now, or do you want to maybe talk about one of the values that's important to you (<-PV->)?

name: routine_political_values
title: Political Values Introduction

variables.default: well, I need you to assign some in the interface first
